source.name: Patched 4chan Archive Ten Billion (repaired & updated)
source.short-desc: Repaired re-dump of the text-only 'Ten Billion' 4chan thread archive, 2005-2008
source.capture:
One 7.8GB payload, chanarchive_dump_v2.sql.gz, plus IA bookkeeping and two thumbnails. Surveyed against archive.org/metadata: 8 files, no image payloads, so no download.exclude is needed.

WHAT IT COVERS: the uploader describes it as a patch/re-dump of the 'Ten Billion' text-only 4chan thread archive — 10.8 million threads and 162 million posts from 2005-2008, originally scraped by an anonymous source, packaged in 2009 and later served by old.sage.moe. That date range is earlier than almost anything else in the registry: the corpus currently has only a few thousand posts before 2008.

RELATIONSHIP TO 4chan_threads_archive_10_billion — THESE ARE TWO RENDERINGS OF THE SAME CORPUS, NOT TWO CORPORA. That manifest holds the XML rendering (22GB across three formats, of which the 4.5GB threads/xml/<board>.tar.gz is the ingestible part, 42 boards, one <thread> file per thread) and still has no adapter because nothing here reads XML. This item is the MySQL rendering of the same data, and is 'patched' — the uploader's word — meaning it repairs faults in the original. Prefer this one if it ingests cleanly: an existing SQL adapter is cheaper than a new XML adapter, and a repaired dump beats an unrepaired one. Do not ingest both without diffing first; overlapping post numbers will simply be rejected by the UNIQUE constraint, but the wasted read is hours.

SCHEMA IS UNKNOWN, WHICH IS WHY ingest.adapter IS NULL. The dump is named chanarchive_dump_v2, not any Fuuka/Asagi convention, and predates both — a 2009 packaging of a 2005-2008 scrape is unlikely to use either schema. Do not guess an adapter: read the CREATE TABLE after download and decide then. fuuka-sql and warosu-sql both recognise board tables by required columns and SILENTLY ACCEPT ZERO TABLES when those are absent, so pointing an existing adapter at this and seeing exit code 0 would prove nothing.

Timestamp handling is also unresolved: the Fuuka family stores America/New_York wall time and needs nyWallToUtc, but whether this dump does the same is unknown and must be checked against known post dates rather than assumed.

prepare.name: decompress the gzipped mysqldump
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && find . -name '*.sql.gz' -not -path './out/*' -not -path './extracted/*' | while read -r f; do b=$(basename "${f%.gz}"); [ -e "extracted/$b" ] || [ -e "out/$b" ] || gunzip -c "$f" > "extracted/$b"; done

prepare.name: stage the .sql dump for ingest
prepare.run: mkdir -p out && find extracted -name '*.sql' -exec sh -c 'cp -al "$1" out/ 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$1" out/' _ {} ';'
